_comment: Festivals the sign-up asks about (D-124; D-35, D-42: asked, never inferred) and the dates they fall on in Malaysia, for profiles.festive_month: the month of the next one on or after the sign-up day (the engine treats it as a yearly month, generator/config.yaml festive). Lunar and Hindu festivals move every year; the dates below are the expected public holidays (Deepavali 2027 the least certain); add later years before they are needed.
